task: held shape visibility, same-contact line endpoint edit, automatic closed-shape direct editing
scope: Drawing subsystem only. Existing PKDrawing archive, tools, selection UI and Undo/store reused. No document migration.

upstream.ported: Unbound single endpoint, no grid/angle/bindings; original geometry plus total drag delta; rotated corner, maintainAspectRatio=true, resizeFromCenter=false; handle grab offset and opposite anchor.
upstream.intentional_difference: Crossing either anchored edge clamps ONE positive minimum scale. Reflections are not supported.
upstream.comparison: Executed extracted ORIGINAL getResizeOffsetXY/getNextSingleWidthAndHeightFromPointer/getResizeAnchor/getResizedOrigin/updateElementCoords/createPointAt/movePoints in Node with elementary bounds/rotation/scene-mutation adapters. 144 resize + 100 drag + 100 endpoint inputs. Not full Excalidraw application or its renderer. handlePointDragging/resizeSingleElement were reviewed, not independently executed.

findings: Old held preview set the parent PKCanvasView layer opacity to zero, including its paper/native display. Selection cleanup unconditionally reset this opacity without owning it.

Old handoff only compared model drawing equality and accepted any finish-rendering callback; manual persistence notifications were not distinguished from native delegate notifications. The screenshots alone do not establish physical-device callback timing.

Actual UIKit touch regression exposed a synchronous native drawing echo at revision 2 followed by identical persistence at revision 3; one render callback arrived with same committed drawing and same viewport, but equality of bookkeeping revisions blocked handoff. Fixed by requiring a native echo of committed CONTENT, then freezing current revision for the CA transaction. Regression simulates this exact ordering.

implementation.ShapeCompletion.swift: Opaque composition of shared paper tiles + retained committed ink + current native shape; native canvas stays renderable underneath. Endpoint editing updates two actual points only; no refit, predicted samples or extra Undo. Final native attributes copied to preview before commit. Native change echo + matching canvas/session/viewport/revision and Core Animation completion gate the handoff; no fixed delay. A synchronous native echo followed by identical bookkeeping does not block handoff. A very fast next native contact retains its own ink and does not overwrite the previous shape session; queued render acknowledgements are drained without polling. Closed-shape input is armed after the original contact ends and model commit succeeds, before preview removal.
implementation.ShapeEditing.swift: Pure ported endpoint/drag/uniform-resize math; rotated frame, opposite anchor, grab offset, finite/zero-length/no-reflection guards.
implementation.NotebookCanvas.swift: Reuse existing outline/handles/InkTransformPreview. Closed shape selection while held, activate gestures between contacts. Stable set of InkStrokeID values resolves into immutable gesture snapshot. Existing PKDrawing transform scales stroke width; retain unaffected geometry/raster cache entries. Native change/render handoff for object transforms.
implementation.DrawingSession.swift: Separate native delegate echo from synchronous persistence notification. Wire shape preview/activation/cancel to host; reuse commit/Undo/redo/store.
